sources.summary: Promotion: Spanish brand Cosentino merges beauty, performance and sustainability with its latest mineral surface material, Éclos, designed to be free of crystalline silica and as elegant as natural stone. Made using Cosentino's most advanced methods and decoration techniques, Éclos is a next-generation engineered stone with rich veining and patterning.
